Hi Ethan — welcome, and thank you for the questionnaire. I pulled Marcus (procurement) and Grace (customer success) into the thread so we can align the MAP and onboarding checklist.

Proposed next steps / quick agenda for a 30–45m kickoff:
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Vendor setup checklist review (W9, bank details, tax forms, vendor contact card) (10m)
3) PO and invoicing workflow (who issues POs, expected lead times, invoice format) (10m)
4) MAP / success criteria and timeline for pilot (deliverables, acceptance tests, go/no-go) (10m)
5) Outstanding compliance questions & legal touchpoints (5m)

I’ve attached our MAP template and the Redwood vendor checklist to help structure the call. Please pre-fill any fields you can on the questionnaire and the checklist; that will let us use the call for clarifications rather than data collection.

Suggested times (PT):
- Tue 4/13: 2:00–2:45pm or 3:30–4:15pm
- Wed 4/14: 9:00–9:45am or 11:00–11:45am

If one of those works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short MAP draft for review.

Thanks, Laura & Ethan. Quick add from procurement side so we can close the intake on the call:

Procurement checklist highlights I’ll want confirmed during the meeting:
- Legal entity name + EIN (matches W9)
- W9 or equivalent tax form (required before PO issuance)
- Bank details or vendor payment portal instructions (for ACH)
- Invoicing cadence and required line-item fields (invoice number, invoice date, PO number, description, amount, tax)
- Any pass-through costs that need special accounting codes (please flag)
- Insurance certificates and SOC2 (if you have one) — if not, provide compensating controls

On the PO timeline: our standard is 7–10 business days after W9 + vendor banking info + approved SOW. If you need an expedited PO, request a procurement expedited approval and we can try to compress to 48–72 hours, but that requires approval from finance.

For the MAP & success criteria: Laura, I suggest we use the MAP template to capture acceptance tests (e.g., validated inference throughput, sample billing reconciliation, security checklist), milestone owner, and target dates. Grace — can you propose two acceptance metrics for the pilot?

Confirming availability for Tue 4/13 3:30–4:15pm PT. I’ll chair the PO/invoice section and will have a short checklist to tick during the call.

On Tue call I’ll share a sample PO format and a sample invoice (PDF) so Nimbus can match fields ahead of first invoice.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
